20261121-chemistry-h3-1.title: Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.topic: Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.material: Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi mai zuwa tana cikin dynamic equilibrium a cikin kwantena mai rufi:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + zafi (ΔH < 0).  Waɗanne yanayi ne ya kamata a daidaita don ƙara yawan ammonia (NH₃) a equilibrium?
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.thinking.0: Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: Amsawar gas mai fitar da zafi mai zuwa tana cikin dynamic equilibrium a cikin kwantena mai rufi:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + zafi (ΔH < 0).  Waɗanne yanayi ne ya kamata a daidaita don ƙara yawan ammonia (NH₃) a equilibrium?
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Tunda amsawar tana fitar da zafi ($\Delta H < 0$), dole ne a rage zafin jiki don amsawar gaba da ke fitar da zafi ta rinjaya. Bugu da ƙari yawan mole na gas yana raguwa daga $4\text{ mol}$ zuwa $2\text{ mol}$, don haka dole ne a ƙara matsin lamba don equilibrium ya koma amsawar gaba da ke rage yawan molecule.
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.hint.1: Amsawar tana fitar da zafi, don haka rage zafin jiki yana matsar da equilibrium zuwa amsawar gaba da ke fitar da zafi. Mole 4 na masu amsawa → mole 2 na samfura, don haka ƙara matsin lamba yana matsar da equilibrium zuwa amsawar gaba mai ƙarancin mole.

20261121-chemistry-h3-2.title: Menene gaskiya game da 'buffer solution'
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.goal: Apply principles of Menene gaskiya game da 'buffer solution' to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.material: Menene gaskiya game da 'buffer solution' da aka yi ta hanyar haɗa girma iri ɗaya na 0.1 M maganin ruwa na acetic acid (CH₃COOH, dissociation constant Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) da 0.1 M sodium acetate (CH₃COONa) a 25 ℃?
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene gaskiya game da 'buffer solution' da aka yi ta hanyar haɗa girma iri ɗaya na 0.1 M maganin ruwa na acetic acid (CH₃COOH, dissociation constant Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) da 0.1 M sodium acetate (CH₃COONa) a 25 ℃?
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Saboda a cikin buffer weak acid ($\text{CH}_3\text{COOH}$) da conjugate base ($\text{CH}_3\text{COO}^-$) suna tare, idan aka ƙara strong acid ($\text{H}^+$) conjugate base yana amsawa, idan kuma aka ƙara strong base ($\text{OH}^-$) weak acid yana amsawa, don haka canjin $\text{pH}$ yana raguwa sosai.
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Buffer yana ƙunshe da weak acid da conjugate base ɗinsa duka.
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.1: Idan acid ya shigo, conjugate base yana shanye shi, idan kuma base ya shigo, weak acid yana neutralize shi.
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o0: Ko da bayan ƙara ɗan strong acid ko strong base, pH ba ya canzawa kusan kwata-kwata kuma yana tsayawa daidai
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o1: Idan aka ƙara strong acid, pH yana faɗuwa zuwa 0 nan take
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o2: Bayan lokaci yana komawa neutral gaba ɗaya (pH = 7) da kansa
20261121-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o3: A cikin buffer ba wata amsawar sinadarai da za ta iya faruwa

20261122-chemistry-h3-1.title: Waɗanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.topic: Waɗanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of Waɗanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.material: [Colligative properties mai zurfi] Waɗanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa game da halayen (colligative properties) na maganin dilute mai ɗauke da solute marar tafiya da non-electrolyte daidai ne? (i) Suna dogara ne kawai akan adadin barbashin solute (molality) ba tare da la'akari da nau'in solute ba. (ii) Matsin tururi ya fi na ruwan tsantsa ƙasa kuma wurin tafasa ya fi girma. (iii) Dokar osmotic pressure ta van 't Hoff ita ce Π = cRT kuma ta yi kama da lissafin yanayin ideal gas.

(i) Suna dogara ne kawai akan adadin barbashin solute (molality) ba tare da la'akari da nau'in solute ba. (ii) Matsin tururi ya fi na ruwan tsantsa ƙasa kuma wurin tafasa ya fi girma. (iii) Dokar osmotic pressure ta van 't Hoff ita ce Π = cRT kuma ta yi kama da lissafin yanayin ideal gas.
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Colligative properties na maganin ba sa dogara da yanayin sinadarin solute sai kawai da adadin barbashi, kuma sun haɗa da rage matsin tururi, ƙara wurin tafasa, rage wurin daskarewa da osmotic pressure ($\Pi = cRT$), don haka (i), (ii) da (iii) duka daidai ne.

20261122-chemistry-h3-2.title: Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.topic: Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.goal: Apply principles of Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.material: Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye (NaN₃), wanda ke kumbura airbag cikin daƙiƙa 0.03 a hatsarin mota, shi ne 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Me ya sa wannan amsawa ta fi dacewa a sinadarai don samar da iskar gas a airbag?
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.thinking.0: Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.prompt: Lissafin ruɓewar sodium azide mai tsayayye (NaN₃), wanda ke kumbura airbag cikin daƙiƙa 0.03 a hatsarin mota, shi ne 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Me ya sa wannan amsawa ta fi dacewa a sinadarai don samar da iskar gas a airbag?
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Sodium azide yana ruɓewa nan take idan aka ba shi tartsatsin wutar lantarki ya samar da iskar nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) mai yawa wanda ba ya cutar da jikin mutum kuma ba shi da aiki a sinadarai, yana kare fasinjoji lafiya idan an yi karo.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Iskar nitrogen (N₂) tana ɗaukar 78 % na iska, ba ta cutar da jikin mutum kuma ba ta ƙonuwa.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.1: Mole 2 na abu mai tsayayye suna zama mole 3 na gas nan take.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o0: Saboda ɗan abu mai tsayayye yana amsawa kuma da saurin fashewa yana samar da iskar nitrogen (N₂) mai aminci kuma mai karko da yawa
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o1: Saboda yana samar da iskar chlorine mai guba da ke tsabtace iska
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o2: Saboda yana sanyi zuwa debe digiri 50 yayin amsawa
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o3: Saboda ba a samar da iskar gas ba kuma airbag yana kumbura a matsayin soso mai tsayayye
